text: 中年人不比年轻人，精力没以前旺盛了，不能胡吃海喝乱造一通了，不能乱造，也就意味着没啥商业价值。
en: Middle-aged people are not like the young; their vigour is not what it used to be, and they can no longer eat and drink to excess and carry on recklessly. Being unable to carry on recklessly means they hold little commercial value.

text: 酒吧、 KTV 啥的基本上都是年轻人的天下，不是说中年人不来这种地方，而是变得少了，不瞒你讲，我年轻时，听到劲爆的 DJ 音乐，都忍不住想要狂扭一通。
en: Bars, KTV and such are basically the young people's domain. It is not that middle-aged people do not come to such places, but they come less often. To tell you the truth, when I was young, hearing thumping DJ music, I could not help but want to dance wildly.

text: 但是现在，感觉这些音乐能把我的心肝震出来，就想赶紧逃离回家，好喝上一口枸杞茶来压压惊。
en: But now, I feel this music could shake my heart and liver right out of me; I just want to escape home at once and have a sip of goji berry tea to calm my nerves.

text: 这种地方，中年人来的少了，就算来，多数也是商务上的应酬，要不你请别人，要不别人请你，所谓应酬，就是不得已而为之。
en: Middle-aged people come to such places less often; even when they do, it is mostly for business entertainment. Either you treat others, or others treat you. So-called business entertainment is something done of necessity.

text: 相比较而言，年轻人都是自发性乱造的，我年轻时也这样，经常和朋友 AA 制，第一场搞完，第二场，第二场搞完第三场…
en: By comparison, young people carouse of their own accord. I was the same when I was young, often going Dutch with friends: finish the first round, then a second; finish the second, then a third…

text: 现在别说 AA 了，就算有人组局请客，别人也不见得来，这蛮尴尬，常常让请客者热脸贴了冷屁股，慢慢地，也没人愿意请客了。
en: Now, never mind going Dutch; even if someone organises a gathering and plays host, others may not even turn up. This is rather awkward, often leaving the host with a warm face pressed to a cold backside. Gradually, no one is willing to play host either.

text: 大家不来的原因很多，人到中年，破事多了，没时间，也没心情，关键是累，身体累，心也累。
en: There are many reasons people do not come. Having reached middle age, there are more trivial troubles, no time, and no mood for it. The key point is exhaustion — the body is tired, and so is the heart.

text: 年轻时和朋友们喝酒，都是从欢声笑语，喝到豪言壮语，再到胡言乱语，再到自言自语，最后到沉默不语。
en: When young and drinking with friends, it would go from laughter and cheerful talk, to grandiose boasts, to nonsense, to talking to oneself, and finally to silence.

text: 开喝时大家都说："总量控制，就这一箱啊"。
en: When the drinking starts, everyone says: "Total amount controlled — just this one case, eh."

text: 但快喝完时，总会有人提议："要不再叫一瓶吧？
en: But when it is nearly finished, someone always suggests: "Shall we get another bottle?"

text: 此时，马上会有人严词声明："好吧，这是最后一瓶！
en: At this moment, someone will immediately declare sternly: "Very well, this is the last bottle!

text: ",这种戏码往往会重复上演好多次…
en: ", this sort of routine often plays out many times over…

text: 中年人的局，大家不会说这么多台词了，还没怎么喝，就有人要走，有人要去接小孩，有人要去接老婆的，还有人要去接…
en: At a middle-aged person's gathering, people no longer say so many lines. Before they have hardly drunk anything, someone wants to leave, someone has to pick up their child, someone has to pick up their wife, and someone else has to pick up…

text: 留下的，没一会就直接到达沉默不语状态，趴在桌上了。
en: Those who stay reach the state of silence before long, and collapse onto the table.

text: 当然，有人确实是体力不支，有的却是利用中年人的身份为装醉打掩护，但咱也分不清啊，因为我也趴桌子上了。
en: Of course, some genuinely lack the stamina, while others use their middle-aged status as cover to fake drunkenness — but we cannot tell them apart, because I am collapsed on the table too.

text: 不管怎么样，中年人的酒，实在喝不动了，酒钱肯定省了不少。
en: Anyway, middle-aged people simply cannot drink any more; we have certainly saved quite a bit on drink.

text: 菜钱呢，也老省了，中年人的友情局，不用点太硬的菜。
en: And we have saved on food as well. For middle-aged friends' gatherings, you do not need to order anything too substantial.

text: 大家不是尿酸高，就是胆固醇高，剩下的别问，问了就是糖尿病，反正太油腻的东西吃不了，清淡一点，有凉拌土豆丝和花生米垫底，就差不多了。
en: Everyone either has high uric acid or high cholesterol; do not ask about the rest — if you do, it is diabetes. Anyway, we cannot eat anything too greasy, so something light, with a base of cold shredded potato and peanuts, is about enough.

text: 所以，支撑人去消费的，不仅仅是钱啊，还有体力，以及一想乱造的心，显然，对于中年人，这些东西都被岁月没收了。
en: So what sustains a person's spending is not just money, but also physical stamina and a heart that longs to carouse. Clearly, for middle-aged people, all these things have been confiscated by the years.

text: 82年，一周前刚刚过完40岁生日！
en: Born in '82, I just celebrated my 40th birthday a week ago!

text: 一个媳妇，一个女儿，两对父母！
en: One wife, one daughter, two sets of parents!

text: 公司最底层管理人员，收入不高不低，够花还能攒点，媳妇和我差不多！
en: The most junior manager at the company; income neither high nor low, enough to spend and still save a bit. My wife is about the same as me!

text: 孩子还小，平时两边父母轮流照看，我们轮流混饭，日子过得挺舒服！
en: The child is still young; usually the parents on both sides take turns looking after her, and we take turns having our meals there — life is quite comfortable!

text: 父母退休金、积蓄足够，不需操心，甚至孩子的花销都不用操心，自己挣钱自己花！
en: Our parents' pensions and savings are sufficient; no need to worry, and we do not even need to worry about the child's expenses — we earn our own money and spend it ourselves!

text: 生活平淡，工作想换沉没成本太高，没有合适机会，在本公司没有什么继续发展的前途！
en: Life is uneventful. I would like to change jobs, but the sunk cost is too high, and there is no suitable opportunity; there is no further room for advancement at this company!

text: 这就是一个40岁衣食无忧，有点小钱，工作不忙，事业无望，未来终归平淡的中年男人的生活状态！
en: This is the living state of a 40-year-old middle-aged man who has food and clothing covered, a bit of spare money, an unhurried job, no career prospects, and a future that will ultimately be uneventful!

text: 三十而立：正是事业刚刚开始建立起来的阶段，立家，立业有一个基本的落实，并且确立自己在为人处事，对待生活上的态度和原则。
en: Thirty and standing firm: this is precisely the stage when one's career has just begun to take shape. Establishing a home and establishing a career find basic realisation, and one sets down one's attitude and principles in conduct and in facing life.

text: 四十而不惑：不为外物和世事形形色色所迷惑，疑惑，对于原来感到的困惑，也渐渐有了认识，有自己的是非、善恶、好坏、美丑的明确判断和识别力。
en: Forty and free of doubt: not confused by external things and the manifold affairs of the world. As for doubts, one gradually comes to understand what once puzzled one, and develops a clear judgement and discernment of right and wrong, good and evil, good and bad, beauty and ugliness.

text: 五十而知天命：明白三分天注定七分靠打拼，谋事在人，成事在天，通过半辈子的生活磨练，经历了人生路上的种种是是非非，亲身经历了身边亲朋好友的起起落落。
en: Fifty and knowing the mandate of Heaven: understanding that three parts are destined by fate and seven parts depend on striving; planning lies with man, success with Heaven. Through half a lifetime of life's tempering, having experienced all manner of rights and wrongs on the journey of life, and personally witnessed the ups and downs of friends and family around one.

text: 回过头来进行总结反思，恍然间大悟，原来人的一生是有一定轨迹的，并非是以人的的意志为转移，节骨眼上重大事项，冥冥之中好像上天早就安排好了似的。
en: Looking back to sum up and reflect, one suddenly sees the light: it turns out a person's life follows a certain trajectory, not to be shifted by human will. At crucial junctures, major matters seem, in some mysterious way, to have been arranged by Heaven long ago.

text: 其实年龄本身没有啥意义对吧
en: Actually, age itself has no real meaning, right?

text: 有意义的事这个年龄代表了什么
en: What is meaningful is what this age represents.

text: 首先肯定是身体技能的下降，这个毋容置疑的，只能延缓衰老，但不能你生长。
en: First, it is certainly the decline of bodily functions — this is beyond doubt. One can only delay ageing, but cannot make one grow young again.

text: 然后是健康状况下降，以前作留下的毛病都开始慢慢爆发。
en: Then there is the decline in health; the ailments left by one's past excesses begin to flare up slowly.

text: 其实以上两点是一切生活质量的基石。
en: In fact, these two points above are the cornerstone of all quality of life.

text: 中年妇女，40，女儿7岁读小学，打死不生二胎的那种
en: A middle-aged woman, 40, daughter 7 years old in primary school, the sort who would rather die than have a second child.

text: 我在互联网大厂工资不低，995，周末偶尔加班，对标阿里P9，年薪百万就是我
en: I work at a big internet company with no low salary, 995, occasional weekend overtime, benchmarked against Alibaba P9 — a million annual salary is me.

text: 战友事业编制，即将被降薪30%，本来钱就不多，降30%也就那样
en: My comrade holds a public-institution post and is about to take a 30% pay cut. He did not have much money to begin with; a 30% cut is just how it is.

text: 3套房子都在一线城市，只有一套有贷款，公积金比房贷多，基本上没有啥负担，存款200+。
en: Three flats, all in first-tier cities; only one has a mortgage, and the housing provident fund exceeds the mortgage payment, so there is basically no burden. Savings 200+.

text: 双方父母都不需要我们，养老金各种保险齐全，而且都有几十万的存款，我们俩几乎全部靠自己，不啃老，他们一辈子的积蓄就只有这么多了。
en: Both sets of parents do not need us; their pensions and various insurances are complete, and each has savings of several hundred thousand. The two of us rely almost entirely on ourselves, not sponging off our parents — what they saved in a lifetime is only this much.

text: 不乱花钱，现在出不去，旅游的钱省了点，努力存款，能run就run，不能润就尽量多存点钱吧
en: We do not spend recklessly. Now we cannot go out, so we have saved a bit on travel. We work hard to save; if we can run, we run; if we cannot, we just try to save a bit more money.

text: 说到这个话题，作为一个年届不惑的追梦人，我想借用我最欣赏的大文人——东坡先生的几句经典名句来表述我对到现在为止的人生之理解：
en: Speaking of this topic, as a dream-chaser approaching forty, I would like to borrow a few classic famous lines from my most admired great man of letters — Mr Dongpo — to express my understanding of life thus far:

text: 1 人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥 苏轼《和子由渑池怀旧》
en: 1. What does life's wandering everywhere resemble? It should resemble a swan goose treading on snow and mud — Shi Su, "Reply to Ziyou: Reminiscing at Mianchi"

text: 公元1061年，苏轼24岁，弟弟苏辙送苏轼到郑州，分手后苏辙写诗给苏轼，苏轼的和诗中的一句。
en: In 1061 AD, Shi Su was 24; his younger brother Zhe Su saw him off to Zhengzhou. After parting, Zhe Su wrote a poem to Shi Su, and this line is from Shi Su's reply poem.

text: 这时候苏轼年轻气壮，正是对人生充满希望和向往的年纪。
en: At this time Shi Su was young and full of vigour, exactly the age full of hope and longing for life.

text: 诗句里是一种恣意豪放的情怀：泥上偶然留指爪，鸿飞那复计东西。
en: The poem conveys a free and uninhibited sentiment: on the mud, claw marks are left by chance; the swan flies off, how could it care about east or west.

text: 在每个人的二十几岁，都是轻松自在的模样，对人生充满了自由自在的向往，尤其满腹诗书有才之人更是如此。
en: Everyone in their twenties appears relaxed and at ease, full of a free and unfettered longing for life — especially those brimming with learning and talent.

text: 对我们80后来说，正好赶上国家大幅发展的时候，对未来有迷茫也有期望。
en: For us post-80s, we happened to come of age as the country developed by leaps and bounds; we feel both confusion and expectation about the future.

text: 因为年轻，所以无畏。
en: Because we were young, we were fearless.

text: 2 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟 《水调歌头·明月几时有》
en: 2. May we live long, though far apart, sharing the beauty of the moon — "Shuidiaogetou: When Will the Bright Moon Appear"

text: 1076年，苏轼39岁，中秋节时他在山东诸城，他思念七年未见的弟弟苏辙，写下千古名篇。
en: In 1076, Shi Su was 39. On the Mid-Autumn Festival, in Zhucheng, Shandong, he missed his younger brother Zhe Su, whom he had not seen for seven years, and wrote this timeless masterpiece.

text: 这个时候，他因为和王安石等政见不合，自求外放，无法与亲人时常团聚，人到中年，诸事不顺。
en: At this time, because his political views differed from those of Anshi Wang and others, he requested a transfer to an outlying post and could not regularly reunite with his family. Having reached middle age, nothing went smoothly.

text: 从20+到30+，对于中国人来说是一个难迈的坎。
en: Moving from one's twenties to thirties is a difficult threshold for Chinese people.

text: 因为“三十而立”是每个人都想追求的事情，过了二十出头的初生牛犊不怕虎，到了临近30岁而一事无成，就会有一种惶惶不可终日的恐慌。
en: Because "thirty and standing firm" is something everyone wants to pursue; having passed the early twenties when one is like a newborn calf unafraid of the tiger, reaching near thirty with nothing accomplished brings a panic of constant unease.

text: 那时候的我们，忘了周围还有很多朋友，忘了家人可以协助，忘了自己也曾有过许多辉煌的瞬间，只觉人生处处障碍、时时艰难。
en: Back then, we forgot that around us there were still many friends, forgot that family could help, forgot that we too had once had many brilliant moments, and only felt that life was full of obstacles and hardship at every turn.

text: 挫折的境遇就像一座围城，走不出来的人久久为之所困，走出来的人必将迎来新的辉煌。
en: A situation of setback is like a besieged city: those who cannot get out are trapped by it for a long time, while those who do get out will surely welcome new brilliance.

text: 3 竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕！
en: 3. A bamboo staff and straw sandals, lighter than a horse — who is afraid!

text: 一蓑烟雨任平生《定风波·莫听穿林打叶声》
en: A palm-leaf cape braves the misty rain through all my life — "Dingfengbo: Listen Not to the Rain Pattering Through the Forest"

text: 1082年，苏轼45岁，这时候他应该在黄州（湖北黄冈）当一个小官，这时候已经走到他人生当中一个极低的点。
en: In 1082, Shi Su was 45. At this time he should have been a minor official in Huangzhou (Huanggang, Hubei), and had reached a very low point in his life.

text: 他俸禄微薄，过着清苦的日子。
en: His salary was meagre, and he lived a frugal and hard life.

text: 为了贴补家用，他只好带着家人在城东开垦了一块坡地，种些粮食瓜果贴补家计。
en: To supplement the household income, he had no choice but to lead his family in clearing a slope east of the city to plant some grain and fruit to help make ends meet.

text: 越是烦恼多，越是接近佛。
en: The more worries one has, the closer one draws to the Buddha.

text: 此时的苏轼看透人间凉薄，已经少了年少轻狂，对政治有了更深刻的理解，也对人生多了很多豁达与宽容。
en: By now Shi Su had seen through the world's coldness; he had lost the reckless arrogance of youth, gained a deeper understanding of politics, and acquired much more openness and tolerance toward life.

text: 在此他自号“东坡居士”，未曾想这个雅号一直被世人沿用，直到千年后的当今，依然如雷贯耳。
en: Here he gave himself the style name "Dongpo Jushi" (Lay Buddhist of the Eastern Slope); little did he expect that this elegant title would be used by the world ever since, and even a thousand years later, today, it remains thunderously well known.

text: 读到他的这首《定风波》，大概没有人不会感受不到强大的能量，这种能量已经不是年轻时的豪言壮志，而是沉淀在内心的一种笃定和坚毅，还有饱经世事的畅快和通透。
en: Reading this "Dingfengbo" of his, hardly anyone could fail to feel its powerful energy. This energy is no longer the grand ambition of youth, but a kind of settled certainty and fortitude deposited deep within, along with the ease and clarity of one who has weathered much of the world.

text: 我们普通人的40+，其实也一样是这样过来。
en: For us ordinary people in our forties and beyond, it is actually the same.

text: 在30-40之间，很多事不那么重要了，很多人不那么在乎了，很多话不那么介意了，重点自然就很清晰了。
en: Between thirty and forty, many things matter less, many people are less cared about, many words are less taken to heart, and the priorities naturally become clear.

text: 而到了40+，谁还那么多愁善感，谁还有那时间唧唧歪歪？
en: And once past forty, who is still so melancholy and sentimental, who still has the time to whinge and complain?

text: 潇洒一点，不是什么坏事。
en: Being free and easy is not a bad thing.

text: 所以，要说40岁左右的中年人是什么人生体会，我想说，如果是正常的人生逻辑，这时候就是上有老下有小，中间还有各种压力和烦恼，的确是“不如狗”的年龄。
en: So, if I were to say what life insight middle-aged people around forty have, I would say that in the normal logic of life, this is the age of having elders above and children below, with all sorts of pressure and worries in between — truly an age "worse than a dog".

text: 但若从人生整体的角度去思量，40岁左右却是人生的攻坚阶段，若能经此一役依然心有阳光，朝着心之所向，人生从此才将走向真正的辉煌。
en: But if one ponders it from the perspective of life as a whole, around forty is actually the crucial stage of life's battle. If, having gone through this campaign, one still holds sunshine in the heart and heads toward what the heart desires, then life from then on will move toward true brilliance.

text: 在过了知天命的时候，苏东坡的一句“人生如逆旅，我亦是行人”对人生做了很好的概括，是啊，漫长的一生中，谁又不是行人呢？
en: Having passed the age of knowing the mandate of Heaven, a line of Dongpo Su's — "life is like a reverse inn, and I too am a traveller" — gives a fine summation of life. Indeed, in this long life, who is not a traveller?

text: 既然是行人，谁又可能在一个地方长久驻足呢？
en: Since we are travellers, who could possibly linger long in one place?

text: 前行是必然，“莫愁前路无知己”，人生道路勇敢行吧！
en: Moving forward is inevitable; "do not grieve that ahead on the road there will be no familiar friend" — walk bravely on the path of life!
